videos.title: Nitin Gadkari
videos.overview: The very first episode of Shekhar Tonite kicks off with none other than Nitin Gadkari joining Shekhar Suman for a conversation that’s equal parts insightful, unfiltered, and outrageously entertaining.

videos.title: Bobby Deol
videos.overview: This week on Shekhar Tonite, Bobby Deol joins Shekhar Suman for a conversation filled with honesty, nostalgia, laughter, stardom, struggles, reinvention, and moments you’ve never seen before.

videos.title: Ali Fazal
videos.overview: An honest, witty, and unfiltered conversation with Ali Fazal and Shekhar Suman, as they dive into stories, perspectives, and moments you don’t usually get to hear.

videos.title: Amruta Fadnavis
videos.overview: This week on Shekhar Tonite, Amruta Fadnavis joins Shekhar Suman for a candid conversation filled with personal stories, music, public life, perspectives on leadership, and moments of honesty, humour, and insight. From balancing multiple roles to navigating life in the public eye, this episode offers a side of Amruta Fadnavis rarely seen before.

videos.title: Manoj Bajpayee
videos.overview: In this episode of Shekhar Tonite, Shekhar Suman and Manoj Bajpayee come together for a candid exchange on life, cinema, ambition, struggles, reinvention, and the stories that shape an artist. From his early days of uncertainty to becoming one of India's most respected actors, Manoj reflects on the journey with honesty, humour, and perspective. A conversation that's insightful, entertaining, and deeply human.

videos.title: Gippy Grewal: The Voice, The Pain, The Journey
videos.overview: Punjabi music sensation and beloved actor Gippy Grewal joins Shekhar Suman on Shekhar Tonite for a conversation that goes far beyond the glitz and glamour. In this episode, Gippy opens up about his incredible journey — from his early struggles to becoming one of the biggest names in Punjabi music and cinema.  He talks candidly about the highs and lows of his career, the emotional moments that shaped him as an artist, and the personal sacrifices behind his success story. Expect raw honesty, heartfelt nostalgia, and a few laughs along the way as Shekhar Suman digs deep into the man behind the music. This is one of the most emotional and real conversations on Shekhar Tonite yet — a must-watch for fans of Gippy Grewal, Punjabi music, and inspiring life stories.

videos.title: Farah Khan
videos.overview: Farah Khan Opens Up on Tees Maar Khan, Marriage, Motherhood, Bollywood & Her Incredible Journey. One of Bollywood's most loved filmmakers, choreographers, and entertainers, Farah Khan joins Shekhar Suman. In this candid episode, Farah Khan shares stories from her extraordinary career, opens up about the highs and lows of Bollywood, reflects on the criticism surrounding Tees Maar Khan, talks about marriage, motherhood, success, failure, and how she reinvented herself in the digital age. Known for her wit and infectious sense of humor, Farah also shares hilarious behind-the-scenes moments, personal anecdotes, and life lessons that make this conversation both inspiring and entertaining. From laughter to heartfelt reflections, this episode has something for every Bollywood fan.

videos.title: Prajakta Koli
videos.overview: Prajakta Koli (MostlySane) joins Shekhar Suman on Shekhar Tonite for one of the most honest and heartfelt conversations yet. From getting rejected at her very first radio internship to becoming the only Indian on the TIME100 Creator list — Prajakta's journey is nothing short of extraordinary. In this full episode, Prajakta Koli talks candidly about building MostlySane from the ground up, the pressure of being a full-time content creator, her popular role as Dimple in Mismatched (Netflix), her debut novel Too Good To Be True, life after marriage, and what she will never trade for fame. She also shares a deeply personal and moving tribute in the confession room that you won't forget.

videos.title: The Voice of a Common Man
videos.overview: In this heartfelt episode of Shekhar Tonite, Shekhar Suman pays tribute to India's middle class—the people who quietly carry the weight of their families, dreams, responsibilities, and the nation itself. From relatable middle-class habits and everyday struggles to hilarious observations on jugaad, savings, and family life, Shekhar delivers a monologue that is both funny and deeply emotional. The episode also features an inspiring conversation with Mumbai auto driver Sandeep Tiwari, who shares his journey, struggles, dreams, unforgettable passengers, and why honesty, kindness, and hope still matter. This is not just a comedy show—it's a celebration of every common man who keeps moving forward despite life's challenges. If you've ever stood in long queues, adjusted with limited resources, dreamed big despite small means, or believed that tomorrow will be better, this episode is for you.

videos.title: Sunidhi Chauhan
videos.overview: This week on Shekhar Tonite, Shekhar Suman welcomes one of India's most iconic and celebrated voices—Sunidhi Chauhan. From her extraordinary musical journey to behind-the-scenes stories, unforgettable performances, career milestones, and candid conversations, this episode is a heartfelt celebration of a voice that has defined generations. Known for her versatility, passion, and unmatched stage presence, Sunidhi opens up like never before in an engaging conversation with Shekhar Suman. Expect laughter, nostalgia, inspiration, music, and plenty of memorable moments.

videos.title: Laalo Team on Their Cannes Journey & Success Story
videos.overview: Every great film begins with a dream. Some dreams make it all the way to Cannes. In this special episode of Shekhar Tonite, Shekhar Suman welcomes the talented creators behind the acclaimed film Laalo—Ankit Sakhiya, Jay Vyas, and Shruhad Goswami. From the challenges of independent filmmaking to earning international recognition and taking Laalo to the Cannes Film Festival, this conversation is filled with inspiring stories, creative struggles, memorable moments, and valuable insights for every cinema lover. If you're passionate about filmmaking, storytelling, or chasing impossible dreams, this is an episode you won't want to miss.
